restaurantName: Ambiente Italiano - Alte Oberförsterei - Ristorante & Trattoria
bio: Dating from 1902, this inviting villa entices guests with its scenic location and excellent cuisine that caters to all tastes. In the trattoria, the menu features Italian classics, pasta made in-house or freshly caught fish, as well as a selection of pizzas. Ristorante Ambiente Italiano, meanwhile, serves more sophisticated dishes that draw on Italian influences. The terrace with its stunning views of the Main River is a summer highlight! The service is friendly and attentive. Good to know: There is a car park directly in front of the building....
